traceability.notes: The story 003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS is fully implemented: both require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation exist, share a consistent function-detection scope, respect a shared configurable scope/exportPriority model, handle JS and TS constructs, and provide clear, actionable error messages with precise locations. Extensive RuleTester coverage and rule documentation are present, and the plugin’s configuration presets include both rules. Arrow functions are explicitly excluded from enforcement by default, matching the requirement. While the story’s Definition of Done checkboxes in the markdown are not all updated, the actual codebase and passing tests demonstrate that the acceptance criteria and technical requirements are satisfied.
